list.heading: My Teams
list.dialogDescription: Create a team and invite your friends. You can then start as many games as you like with them.
list.emptyText: You're not part of any team. Create one to get started!

detail.deletedDescription: The team and its related data were removed.
detail.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete the team, its memberships, invitations and all of its games, with their resolutions, bingo cards and related gameplay data. Archived games are kept. This action cannot be undone.
detail.leaveDescription: You will also leave every running game of this team that you play: your bingo cards, leaderboard entries and the resolutions written for you are deleted. The resolutions you wrote for others stay on their cards. You can only come back with a new invitation. If you are the only Team Admin, promote another member first.
detail.noGamesCanCreate: No games yet. Click "New Game" to create one.

inviteDialog.title: Invite Members
inviteDialog.description: Create an invite link to share with your friends.

newGameDialog.title: New Game
newGameDialog.description: Start a new game with this team and choose who plays. No one needs to be invited again.

membersList.title: Team Members
membersList.makeLeaderDescription: Team Admins can invite members, create, start, end and delete games, promote other members and delete the team. This cannot be undone.

join.title: Join a Team
join.invited: You've been invited to join a Resolution Bingo team!
join.ready: Ready to join? Click the button below to accept the invitation.
join.loginNeeded: You'll need to be logged in to join the team.
